quoted.text:
The seething rage at this post would be hilarious if it wasn't so depressingly satanic. 

"The bell curve! IQ! Korea adoption study! REEEEEEEEEEEEE!" 

Yes. And?

Let me go ahead and just grant all your frantic, obsessive claims about group differences. Have them all. Let's assume you're right about everything.

It still changes nothing about the truths that govern children of God:

All human beings are made in God's image, equal before Him in their worth and dignity and claim to justice. Our laws should treat everyone equally, without partiality. 

Mankind is not merely an animal, and to treat him as such is a blasphemous affront to the God who created him

We should judge individuals by their actions and character rather than by their racial group

Some cultures are inherently better than others, and there's nothing wrong with avoiding bad cultures or preventing immigration from bad cultures. 

Nurture, religion, culture, and choices are all much more powerful determinants of who you will become than DNA is

God uses the weak to shame the strong and the foolish to shame the wise. Your racial pride and your confidence in your ancestry will damn you to Hell.  

Godless anthropology and pagan superstition, both of which feature a disordered worship of nature, always end in death and injustice. Every time. I don't care how good your intentions are.
